title.zh: 贩毒得益追缴修正命令 2007
title.en: DRUG TRAFFICKING RECOVERY OF PROCEEDS AMENDMENT ORDER 2007

source.name: Attorney General's Chambers, Brunei Darussalam (AGC) — LAWS OF BRUNEI / Government Gazette

text.en: This Order may be cited as the Drug Trafficking (Recovery of Proceeds) of section 7 of Chapter 178.

Section 7 of the Drug Trafficking (Recovery of Proceeds) Act, is amended by adding the following new subsection - "14) Any amount recovered or in satisfaction of a confiscation order shall be paid into the Criminal Offences Confiscation Fund established under 30(1) of the Criminal Conduct (Recovery of Proceeds) Order, 2000 (S 52/2000).". of new section 23A.

The Act is amended by inserting the following new section immediately after of Attorney General. 23A. Where, in relation to any designated country, no authority has been specified in an order made under section 23{ 1), a certificate made by the Attorney General by notification in the Gazette to the effect that any authority specified therein is the appropriate authority for the purposes of that section and of the other provision of this Act as modified by an order made under that section, is sufficient evidence of that fact.". I Made this 21st. day of Jamadilawal, 1428 Hijriah corresponding to the 7th. day of June, 2007 at Our Istana Nurul lman, Bandar Seri Begawan, Brunei Darussalam.

THE SULTAN AND YANG DI-PERTUAN

DARUSSALAM
